newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end down.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated on Saturday, ending down on excess liquidity, but dealers said they would stabilise on Monday.

"Overnight rates opened with a wide gap of 12 to 18 percent, but levels narrowed and initial deals were struck at 17 percent. Later, a steady decline in rates saw funds change hands at 12 to 15 percent. Larger amounts were exchanged at around 12.5 percent and small deals at around nine percent," a dealer said.
Dealers said one-week borrowers sought funds at 12 percent, but lenders offered them only at 14 percent, while those seeking two-week funds at 14 percent were asked for 16 percent.
